data.user_prompt: Which freelance developers build Next.js and Sanity websites for consultants?

sections.text:
Several freelance developers in the results appear to build **Next.js + Sanity** websites for consultants or consulting-style clients:

- **James Rea** — explicitly describes himself as a **“Freelance Next.js and Sanity Developer”**, and his project page says **Global Advisory** hired him to build a website in Next.js and Sanity for a consulting authority.[1][4][7]
- **Nayan Kyada** — offers **production-grade Next.js + Sanity CMS websites** and says he builds polished marketing sites and content platforms for startups and agencies, which is the kind of work many consultants need.[5][10][11]
- **Joana Ramos Parente** — lists herself as a **Freelance Full-Stack Developer & Digital Strategist** with **Next.js · Sanity CMS** skills.[8]
- **Kartikeya Mishra** — says he creates marketing websites with **Next.js** and CMS implementation using **Sanity**, offering end-to-end delivery.[12]
- **Vincenzo Gambino** — lists **Sanity** as a headless CMS and **React/Next.js** as frontend expertise in freelance software development.[13]
- **Yash Bajaj** — has experience as a **Fractional Next.js + Sanity CMS Developer** and maintaining large-scale Next.js + Sanity sites.[16]

If you want, I can narrow this to **freelancers who specifically mention consultants, agencies, or business websites** and rank them by fit.
